newsitem.title: USA: Titan Wheel Dutch auction tender completed.
newsitem.headline: Titan Wheel Dutch auction tender completed.

text.p: Titan Wheel International Inc said Monday it completed its Dutch auction tender offer and plans to purchase 3,763,919 shares of its common stock at $15 a share.
The company began its tender offer on February 25 with the intention to purchase up to five million shares at a range of $12.50 to $15 a share.
The shares repurchased under this tender represent approximately 15 percent of the 25.5 million common shares outstanding immediately prior to the offer.

Titan will continue to have authority to repurchase, under its existing stock repurchase program, an additional 4.4 million common shares in the open market. This repurchase program will not acquire shares in the open market prior to April 15, 1997.
Titan supplies mounted tire and wheel systems for off-highway equipment.
